chunks: Abu Basir asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام:
about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “And complete the number”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Aba Abdillah, Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.أَبُو بَصِيرٍ: Abu Basir, the questioner and narrator in the report
key_terms.الْعِدَّةَ: the prescribed number or count of days
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: the statement of Allah in the Qur'an

ai.seo_question: What does “And complete the number” mean in Qur'an 2:185 according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase “And complete the number” as referring to completing thirty days. In context, it indicates a legal and devotional understanding related to the counting of days in fasting.
